verdict.rationale: Google claims Gemini CLI supports Google account sign-in and lists 'Enterprise features: Advanced security and compliance,' implying enterprise identity/Cloud auth support (gh-13, gh-15), but a hands-on report shows Workspace (enterprise) accounts explicitly failing to log in ('Ensure your Google account is not a Workspace account'), directly undermining the enterprise-auth claim. Missing for 10: documentation of specific enterprise IdP/SSO or Cloud IAM integration, resolution of the Workspace login failure, and independent confirmation that enterprise accounts work reliably.
